title: Basement — baseline and first pass
summary: Current production focus. The images are native editor evidence, not generated concepts. Existing art is documented separately from proposals; use Edit to record review decisions.

items.title: 01 / Existing corridor
items.alt: Standalone Basement corridor captured in Unreal Engine 5.8.4 on 12 November 2026
items.body:
**Observed, 12 November 2026.** Repeating structural walls, a cracked concrete floor and a line of ceiling lights establish the corridor. This is the existing art.

Captured from `/Game/Levels/Streaming_Levels/Basement`, at approximately `(5005, 3371, -957)` cm; FOV 90°. No level, material or lighting edits were saved. This is an editor viewport, not a gameplay performance capture.

The Basement was opened standalone. The global `Main_Lights`/assembly context still needs a matched capture before judging final exposure, color or visibility.

items.title: 02 / The equipment shop is the destination
items.body:
**Owner-defined role:** a character at the end of the hallway supplies and/or sells the janitor's equipment. The character and shop gameplay are outside this environment pass.

**Verified:** the engine contains `Basement_Shop_C_1`; the Blender `Shop` collection has 16 direct objects.

**Proposed review:** establish the player approach, the counter silhouette and a clear focal point using the existing scene. A second close camera probe was too dark to judge, so it is not presented as an appearance reference. Inspect it with the complete lighting context first.

items.title: 03 / Build from the current kit
items.alt: Native Blender window showing an existing modular wall, UV editor and source collection hierarchy
items.body:
**Source evidence:** `Interior_Building.blend` opens correctly in Blender 5.2.4 LTS. The screenshot shows the existing source workspace, not a new wall design.

`Modular_Walls` has seven direct objects. Floor, roof, stair and decoration collections already exist. Audit grid lengths, corners, pivots and UV scale before inventing new parts. Use a copy for the first export/reimport trial.

The Assets subtab records three missing external images and their associated `.sbs` sources.

items.title: 04 / Proposed first environment pass
items.body:
1. Capture the corridor approach, shop front and one junction in the assembled lighting context.
2. Verify one wall/floor/corner set on the grid and through one copied Blender → Unreal round trip.
3. Mark visible module gaps, repeated surfaces and prop opportunities directly against those views.
4. Propose a small 1970s service-area treatment: institutional signage, utility fixtures and controlled wear, while keeping the dungeon-like neglect. These details are proposals, not established references.
5. Implement the chosen pass, capture the same views and profile in gameplay against the RTX 2060 / Ryzen 5 5600 target.

**Done means:** source preserved, joints and scale checked, route/shop readable, matching before/after evidence and a recorded owner decision. No environment redesign has been implemented yet.
